title: ProveML: Inline Claim Markup for Deterministic Verification of AI-Generated Text
description:
Paper, benchmarks, experiment artifacts and reproducibility guide for ProveML: a Markdown extension in which an LLM marks entities, values and threshold-bound judgments inline, and a verifier resolves each claim against a flat key-value fact store by string equality or arithmetic, with no model in the verification loop.

Includes the manuscript source, two benchmarks (a fully synthetic education dataset and SEC EDGAR FY2025 filings), all convergence runs across four models, a reimplemented SymGen baseline, ablations on prompt language and context selection, a markup coverage audit, and a deterministic bibliography verifier.
